realToolSessionId: Root records the actual exec tool ID separately before any operation and verifies it remains alive before every phase. Never infer it from pid.

progressFormat.sequence: next integer1..128, chosen by progress CLI
progressFormat.versionId: exact native saved-version ID if observed
progressFormat.deploymentId: exact native deployment ID if observed
progressFormat.evidencePath: absolute regular sanitized evidence file, required for terminal update
progressFormat.evidenceSha256: exact64hex of that evidence file, required for terminal update

beforeProviderCall: wait for progress CLI success and accepted sequence; inspect fresh guard liveness/deadline; only then make the external call
unknownProviderRule: preserve the unresolved shared ledger across local timeout/release; no new operation until actual provider reconciliation
reconcileOnly: permits evidence-bound update of an existing unresolved operation, never begin
audienceBasis: root-supplied previous successful private publications at revision3 and unchanged current metadata; no native mutation probe
pidQualification: Diagnostic within the guardian execution namespace only; inspect never probes this PID. Root must verify the actual tool session separately before every phase.
inspectScope: held-state metadata, exact request, fresh heartbeat and unexpired deadline only; returns actualToolSessionCheckRequired:true.
